subject.title: fix(memory): search memory and wiki concurrently for corpus=all (#92633)

question: Should this PR keep closing wording for the broader all-corpus timeout issue, or should it land as the concurrency fix while leaving attribution/debug work open?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and appropriate, but the linked issue asks for both reduced all-corpus latency and better timeout attribution/debug output, and the latter is still owned by a separate open PR.

options.title: Narrow Closure Before Merge
options.body: Change the PR body from closing syntax to a normal link or add a maintainer note that this PR handles concurrency while the broader issue remains open for attribution/debug work.

options.title: Accept Scoped Closure
options.body: Treat the concurrency fix as the central resolution and let the issue close while preserving attribution/debug as a separate open PR.

options.title: Pause For Coordination
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers choose whether the concurrency and attribution fixes should land together or as explicitly split work.

recommendation.title: Narrow Closure Before Merge
recommendation.body: Change the PR body from closing syntax to a normal link or add a maintainer note that this PR handles concurrency while the broader issue remains open for attribution/debug work.
